versions.changelog:
- Added greater emphasis on the global endpoint (adp-global.laiye.com) as default for international users.
- Swapped and clarified the order of registration links: "Global" now precedes "China Mainland" throughout.
- Updated example commands to use variable filename extensions for Base64 extraction input, improving flexibility.
- Minor language tweaks to streamline terminology and improve clarity for global users.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

- Documentation updated to clarify concurrency limits for invoice extraction.
- Free users are now limited to 2 concurrent documents; paid users can process up to 10 concurrently.
- No code changes in this version.

- Initial release of invoice-recognition-and-extract skill.
- Provides global, multi-language, multi-currency invoice extraction with zero configuration.
- Accurately extracts structured data: invoice number, date, supplier, buyer, currency, tax amount, total, and line items from invoices, receipts, and bills.
- Supports all file types (PDFs, scans, photos) and multiple input methods (URL, local file, Base64).
- Includes full CLI setup instructions, command mappings, and detailed usage guidance.
- Offers 100 free monthly credits; limited-time bonus of 1,000 pages invoice extractions for new users.
